row.notes: (memStream{data,size},...): reads a TGA header: id length, skip 1, image type, skip 9, width u16, height u16, bpp, descriptor, skips the id field; pixel start = stream pos; if bpp/8*w*h fits, returns Ne_Tga_ConvertToRgba8Buffer(type,w,h,bpp,desc,pixels,p2,p3,p4), else 0. Old note (packet header writer, callers) wrong. Callers in .data1: 0x151fbc660, Game_TrackInfo_LoadPhysicsMap_Body.
